title: View kernel messages page by page
summary: Display kernel messages in a paginated view using 'less', allowing you to scroll through the output one screen at a time. This is helpful when the log is too long to read in one go.

aliases.text: view kernel messages page by page

steps.explain: Pipe the output of dmesg to 'less' to view the messages interactively, one page at a time.
steps.expect: The terminal enters a pager mode showing the first page of kernel messages. Use arrow keys to scroll and 'q' to quit.
